title: Bed-Hold Notice Requirements Across the Bed-Hold and Leave Reservations Tiers
content:
Every tier of **Bed-Hold and Leave Reservations** carries the same written-notice terms. The figures and requirements below apply identically to the Medicaid Hospital Leave Reserved Bed, the Medicaid Therapeutic Leave Reserved Bed, the Private Pay Hospital Leave Bed Hold, the Private Pay Therapeutic Leave Bed Hold, the Medicare Skilled Stay Hospital Leave Bed Hold and the Medicare Skilled Stay Therapeutic Leave Bed Hold.

| Term | Value on every tier |
|---|---|
| Written bed-hold policy given at admission (42 CFR 483.15(d)(1)) | Yes |
| Written bed-hold notice stating the hold duration and cost given at the time of transfer (42 CFR 483.15(d)(2)) | Yes |
| Hours after an emergency transfer within which the written notice reaches the resident or representative (CMS guidance F625) | 24 |
| A day held before the transfer notice was delivered may be charged to the resident | No |
| Who receives the bed-hold notice | the resident and the representative |

**Reading the 24-hour term.** The hours run from the departure time of an emergency transfer. Taking a hypothetical emergency departure at 02:30, a notice that reaches the representative at 01:45 the following day is within the 24 hours; one reaching the representative at 03:00 that following day is not.

**Reading the charging term.** Because no tier allows a day held before the transfer notice was delivered to be charged to the resident, the delivery of that notice is the earliest point from which a held day can be the resident's charge, whatever the tier.
